I replied to Pree in her DM to confirm I've noted it: her standing Cinder rollout call with the Marrow Fieldworks team is now on Mondays at 11:45. She said no action was needed, so I didn't touch her calendar or anything else.

The knowledge brain had already saved her message as a fact, so I didn't add a second copy.

**Possible privacy gap:** that saved fact is marked as coming from her private DMs, but its visibility is set to "world". The workspace rules say only Pree should see what she tells me in a DM. If "world" means other people's searches can turn it up, the brain owner should check that setting. I didn't change it myself, because deleting the fact would lose the reminder she asked me to keep.
